fullDescription.text: Review eval for untrusted data: If untrusted data (data from HTTP requests, user submitted files, etc.) is included in an eval statement it can allow an attacker to inject their own code.

help.text: Edit the eval so that no untrusted data is included. If untrusted data is absolutely necessary a great deal of care should be taken to ensure it is properly escaped so that it cannot be executed. This is not as simple as just escaping quotes.
help.markdown: Visit [https://github.com/Microsoft/DevSkim/blob/main/guidance/DS189424.md](https://github.com/Microsoft/DevSkim/blob/main/guidance/DS189424.md) for guidance on this issue.
